name: contracts
description: The API grammar of decision 0014, checked on the OpenAPI documents a project publishes (docs/design/naming.md).

messages.contractVersion: info.version {{version}} is no api-version (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD-preview)
messages.contractParam: {{path}}: parameter {{param}} is not a full lowerCamel name ending in Name or Id
messages.contractPut: {{path}}: a PUT path has an even number of segments (collection and name pairs)
messages.contractBoolean: {{at}}: boolean {{name}} starts with is; name the state
messages.contractSystemData: {{at}}: a resource without {{field}}, which its model's contract asks
messages.contractNextLink: {{at}}: a list without {{field}}, which its model's contract asks
